I've answered Marcus in his DM: his dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups is **Gate 35**.

That comes from his own message to me on Oct 14, when he asked me to remember that Gate 35 would be his Thornbury dock on the Juniper project from then on. The answer only uses what he told me in his own DM, so nothing from anyone else's conversations went into it.
